name: minijoy
description: miniJoy on Stacks with 5 rare NFT contracts

scripts.settings:init: for n in Simnet Devnet Testnet Mainnet; do [ -f settings/$n.toml ] || cp settings/$n.toml.example settings/$n.toml; done
scripts.deploy:generate: npm run settings:init && clarinet deployments generate --mainnet --manual-cost
scripts.deploy: npm run settings:init && clarinet deployments apply --mainnet --use-on-disk-deployment-plan
scripts.deploy:generate:testnet: npm run settings:init && clarinet deployments generate --testnet --manual-cost
scripts.deploy:generate:mainnet: npm run settings:init && clarinet deployments generate --mainnet --manual-cost
scripts.deploy:testnet: npm run settings:init && clarinet deployments apply --testnet --use-on-disk-deployment-plan
scripts.deploy:mainnet: npm run settings:init && clarinet deployments apply --mainnet --use-on-disk-deployment-plan
